summary: Frontend-only test of the 5 new Contabilità guide chapters and the '?' help mapping for accounting pages. Admin and contabile see 16 chapters on /guida; the 5 coge chapters are numbered 12-16 with the correct titles in both the sections and the index (guida-indice-*). The eyebrow reads 'Manuale per operatori e contabili'. Operatore sees 11 chapters, none of them coge, and the eyebrow 'Manuale per gli operatori'. Searching 'chiusura' shows only guida-cap-coge-chiusura for admin and contabile; for operatore it shows guida-empty. Help mapping for admin and contabile: prima-nota, registrazione-veloce, mastrini, bilancio, chiusura and piano-conti each open the right 'Aiuto · Contabilità · ...' title with the matching chapter and number. For operatore, /contabilita/prima-nota (and the other accounting pages) shows 'Primi passi'. The earlier mappings are unchanged (/fatture -> Fatture, TD04 -> Note di credito, /ddt -> DDT, /impostazioni -> Primi passi for admin). help-open-guida goes to /guida#coge-*, closes the sheet and does not lock the body. coge-prima-nota and coge-veloce scroll to top=16px. The last chapters (schede, chiusura, piano) cannot reach the top because the page is already at its maximum scroll (scrollY = max 6352), but they are fully visible. All quoted labels exist: Nuova registrazione, Incasso, Pagamento, Stampa giornale, Registra documenti mancanti, Aliquota, Registra, Anteprima scritture, Aggiungi, and the tabs Piano dei conti, Causali contabili, Codici IVA and Parametri. The button 'Conferma chiusura {anno}' was found as 'Conferma chiusura 2025'. 'Annulla chiusura' is not shown on screen because no year is closed in the test data; it exists in Chiusura.jsx:73 (shown only when d.chiuso).

ui_bugs.component: Guida hash scroll for the last chapters
ui_bugs.issue: From /contabilita/chiusura or /contabilita/piano-conti, /guida#coge-chiusura and #coge-piano land with the chapter at top 392px and 708px, because the document cannot scroll further. The chapter is fully visible. This is cosmetic only. A fix is optional: add bottom padding (e.g. pb-[60vh] on the chapter list) so the last chapters can reach the top.

action_items: Optional: add bottom spacing on /guida so hash links to the last chapters scroll them to the top.
critical_code_review_comments: For contabile and operatore without the 'tabelle_contabili' right, /contabilita/piano-conti redirects to /dashboard. The coge-piano chapter is still shown to every contabile; it already says that editing needs that right, which is fine.
The texts quote 'Conferma chiusura' while the button reads 'Conferma chiusura 2025'. This is acceptable.
